drhp.business: Andhra Paper Limited manufactures and sells a wide range of writing, printing, industrial, and copier papers. The Company operates an integrated manufacturing platform with in-house pulp capacity, serving a diverse domestic customer base through a robust dealership network while also maintaining a small export presence. It is strategically expanding into value-added products and the high-growth tissue and hygiene segment.

drhp.expansion: During FY 2025-26, the Company substantially completed its flagship mill modernisation programme across Rajahmundry and Kadiyam units. Plant upgrades and de-bottlenecking totalling ₹520 Crores were completed between 2022 and 2026.
